text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I offer my thanks to your skill as a noble knight
who worked quietly in the shadows of my brilliance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's head right back and prepare the stage!
These little ones are waiting eagerly!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that's it! Today, I shall specially prepare
a premier seat just for you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: T-The best seat in the house?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's an S-tier seat right in the middle of the front row! As a reward for that splendid rescue, bask in my radiance to your heart's content!
